answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and let peers slash that stake when an identity misbehaves. A single operator spinning up hollow shells must fund each one, so the cost of a fake army scales linearly while honest agents pay once. Reputation then grows like a trellis: each verified deal adds a thread of trust between real counterparties, and new identities with no threads and no stake stay quarantined until they earn their way in.
